Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 33 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Pallavi - 28 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Ajay - 27 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Anjali - 59 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
5. Meenakshi - 32 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree
4. The potter's yard - a wheel, clay pots

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Vinod stands on the training ground. Pallavi and Anjali stand near him.]

Vinod: "Mother, what's the plan today?"

[Vinod practises sword fighting.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

[Vinod draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Vinod (laughing): "Well done!"

[Vinod mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Vinod: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vinod swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Pallavi: "Really?"

[Vinod shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Vinod (laughing): "Pallavi, listen!"

[Pallavi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Vinod: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Anjali stands near him.]

Vinod: "Let's begin."

[Vinod orders food on his phone.]

Anjali: "That's great!"

[Vinod jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Anjali: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The fields - Day

[Vinod stands in the fields. Anjali and Ajay stand near him.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod ploughs the field.]

Ajay (excited): "Okay, Vinod."

[Vinod harvests the wheat with a sickle.]

Vinod: "Yes, of course."

[Vinod rests under the tree in the shade.]

Vinod: "I'm ready!"

[Vinod wipes his brow in the hot sun.]

Ajay (laughing): "And then?"

Scene 4: The potter's yard - Day

[Vinod stands in the yard. Anjali and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "What a nice place."

[Vinod shapes a clay pot on the potter's wheel.]

Anjali: "And then?"

[Vinod paints the clay lamps.]

Meenakshi: "What a day to remember!"
